name: Pukekura Park
bio: A 52-hectare Victorian park of lakes, fernery, waterfalls and tropical gardens, with a lit-up summer festival.

name: Te Rewa Rewa Bridge
bio: A whale-skeleton-shaped pedestrian bridge on the Coastal Walkway, framing Mount Taranaki.

name: Len Lye Centre
bio: A mirrored-steel gallery of kinetic sculpture and film by Len Lye, joined to the Govett-Brewster Art Gallery.

name: Paritutu Rock
bio: A steep rock stack with a short scramble to a view over the city and Mount Taranaki.

name: Puke Ariki
bio: A waterfront museum, library and visitor centre telling the story of Taranaki.

name: Coastal Walkway
bio: A 13-km paved walking and cycling path along the coast between Bell Block and Port Taranaki.

name: Mount Taranaki
bio: A 2,518-metre dormant volcano with a demanding summit climb and views over the whole region.

name: Pouakai Tarns
bio: Small tarns beside Pouakai Hut that mirror Mount Taranaki in calm weather.

name: Dawson Falls
bio: An 18-metre waterfall on the Kapuni Stream, reached by a short walk through goblin forest.

name: Wilkies Pools
bio: Natural pools in a stream, on a loop track through mossy forest near the Egmont visitor centre.

name: Pouakai Crossing
bio: A day walk across the Pouakai Range with views of Taranaki and the tarns.
